structuralFindings: Rates are quoted PER ROOM PER NIGHT (Double/Single columns), not per person — a different pricing unit from every Soroi and most other beach properties checked, which quote per person per night. Do not divide by 2 to get a per-person figure without checking with the property — the 'DOUBLE KSH' figure appears to be the full room rate for 2 people, and 'SINGLE KSH' the full room rate for 1 (roughly 75% of the double rate in most rows, except Executive Suite and Ocean Breeze Suite where Single = Double, i.e. no single discount on those two categories).
Currency is KES (Kenya Shillings), not USD — no USD conversion given on this page.
Base plan is All Inclusive for every season shown.

Five date windows in total, but only two have genuinely different pricing: the Christmas/New Year window (23 Dec-3 Jan, 5-night minimum, +New Year's Eve supplement) is materially higher, and 1 May-30 Jun is materially lower ('low season'). The other three windows (1 Sep-22 Dec 2025, 4 Jan-30 Apr 2026, 1 Jul-30 Nov 2026) all share the exact same rate table.
Executive Suite and Ocean Breeze Suite are priced per-room flat (Single = Double, no discount for solo occupancy) — different behavior from the four other room categories.
